# Error Handling & Edge Cases Requirements Quality Checklist: Abrir Arquivo Pelo Título

**Purpose**: Validate requirement completeness and precision for file refusals, malformed encodings, size limits, and environmental failures
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Ingestion Refusal & Format Violations

- [x] CHK001 - Are the rejection criteria for non-UTF8 or binary files specified with named error codes (`InvalidUtf8` / `FormatUndeliverable`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK002 - Does the spec define what happens when an empty (0 bytes) document is selected by the user? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the user-facing feedback mechanism for files exceeding 93.636 bytes defined without disrupting current playback (inline banner / `reasonBanner` / `liveRegion`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-015]

## System & Environmental Failure Modes

- [x] CHK004 - Does the specification define behavior when the host Android OS lacks a document provider or SAF activity throws an unresolvable intent exception? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK005 - Are recovery requirements specified if the local storage (`filesDir/snapshots`) runs out of disk space during snapshot copy? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the behavior specified if the app process is placed in background or killed while the Android SAF picker activity is open? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-016]

## Closed Set Compliance & Diagnostics

- [x] CHK007 - Are all error outcomes mapped to a closed set of reasons without generic fallback variants (`_ =>` / `Other`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 - Does the specification mandate that failed ingest attempts emit diagnostic records without advancing the transport clock? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Notes

- Todos os 8 itens avaliados e formalizados no `spec.md` (§FR-014 a §FR-017, §Edge Cases).
